observations.statement: Between 2026-09-19…2026-10-02 vs 2026-10-03…2026-10-16 the tracked conversion rate went from 4.19% to 1.84% (−56.0%); the change is statistically significant (p < 0.001).
Daily conversion rate averaged 4.18% before 2026-10-04 and 1.67% from 2026-10-04 on (change point; 15 vs 13 days, −60.0%).
The pixel recorded 97% of backend-confirmed conversions in the baseline (527 of 543) but only 42% of backend-confirmed conversions in the current period (233 of 550).
Change #3 at 2026-10-03 22:15 UTC, category deploy, by web-team (text in untrusted content).

evidenceIndex.E1: Baseline 2026-09-19…2026-10-02: 12,585 sessions, 527 tracked conversions, CR 4.19%, spend $31,363.3; current 2026-10-03…2026-10-16: 12,656 sessions, 233 tracked conversions, CR 1.84%, spend $31,709.82.
evidenceIndex.E2: Tracked CR changed from 4.19% (527 / 12,585 sessions, 2026-09-19…2026-10-02) to 1.84% (233 / 12,656 sessions, 2026-10-03…2026-10-16): −2.35 pp (−56.0%); two-proportion z-test p < 0.001, 95% CI of the difference [−2.77 pp, −1.93 pp] — significant; −21.0 tracked conversions/day.
evidenceIndex.E3: Daily conversion rate averaged 4.18% before 2026-10-04 and 1.67% from 2026-10-04 on (change point; 15 vs 13 days, −60.0%).
evidenceIndex.E4: No source explains the CR change out of proportion to its traffic: the largest contributor, google_search, accounts for 69% of the −2.35 pp change with 70.2% of baseline sessions.
evidenceIndex.E5: All 2 source segments changed CR by a similar relative amount (−57.3% to −55.5%); mix effect +0.00 pp, rate effect −2.35 pp.
evidenceIndex.E6: No device explains the CR change out of proportion to its traffic: the largest contributor, mobile, accounts for 55% of the −2.35 pp change with 54.9% of baseline sessions.
evidenceIndex.E7: All 2 device segments changed CR by a similar relative amount (−56.4% to −55.8%); mix effect −0.00 pp, rate effect −2.35 pp.
evidenceIndex.E8: The pixel recorded 97% of backend-confirmed conversions in the baseline (527 of 543) but only 42% of backend-confirmed conversions in the current period (233 of 550).
evidenceIndex.E9: Largest funnel step change: form_submit→lead_submitted 0.8378 → 0.3675 (−56.1%); other steps: page_view→form_start 0.1829 → 0.1825, form_start→form_submit 0.2788 → 0.28.
evidenceIndex.E10: Change #1 at 2026-09-22 09:30 UTC, category budget, by ppc-manager (text in untrusted content).
evidenceIndex.E11: Change #2 at 2026-09-30 14:00 UTC, category other, by ppc-manager (text in untrusted content).
evidenceIndex.E12: Change #3 at 2026-10-03 22:15 UTC, category deploy, by web-team (text in untrusted content).
evidenceIndex.E13: Change #4 at 2026-10-08 11:00 UTC, category traffic, by ppc-manager (text in untrusted content).
